task.title: Report the correct command in config unset JSON envelopes
task.description:
workbook config unset --json reports "command":"config set". writeProjectSetting hardcodes the verb for both the set and unset paths at internal/cli/config.go:166.

Machine-readable output is a first-class interface for this project, and an agent keying on the command member of the result envelope sees the wrong verb for a command that did the opposite of what the envelope claims.

Acceptance:
- config unset reports "command":"config unset".
- config set is unchanged.
- A test asserts the command member for both, so the two cannot drift back together.
